pages.text: A core will not activate without Stabilizers. Place four of them in a cross around the core, all on the same plane (horizontal or vertical), each one in line with the core and within 16 blocks of it.$(br2)From tier 5 up each of the four must be an $(l)advanced stabilizer$(): nine Stabilizers placed as a flat 3x3 square facing the core.
Right-clicking a linked Stabilizer opens the core's screen, which tells you if the structure or the stabilizers are wrong.

pages.title: Beams
pages.text: While the core is active, its stabilizer beams act as a force field: anything living that walks into one is pushed out sideways and takes half a heart every half second. Creative and spectator players pass through.$(br2)Servers can change the damage, turn the push off, or limit it to players or mobs in the config ($(l)beamForceField$() and the $(l)beam$() settings).
